title: Vesper and the Weather
author: Ines Quintana
blurb: Ansel Crane, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
